subject.title: fix(skills): pass ownerHandle in ClawHub bulk verdict targets to resolve ambiguous slugs

question: Should OpenClaw merge client-side `ownerHandle` forwarding only after ClawHub has deployed and documented bulk-endpoint support, or should this PR be held until both sides can land as one verified change?
rationale: The linked reproduction shows that the current deployed service does not resolve the field, so repository review cannot safely choose a cross-service rollout order without the owning maintainers' intent.

options.title: Coordinate and verify both sides
options.body: Hold this PR until the bulk endpoint consumes `ownerHandle`, then add a live ambiguous-slug proof and merge the compatible client update.

options.title: Adopt a client fallback
options.body: Design and approve a bounded owner-qualified single-verify fallback for bulk failures, with explicit behavior and trust-state semantics.

options.title: Defer the OpenClaw change
options.body: Pause this branch until the ClawHub API contract is available and an end-to-end integration path is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Coordinate and verify both sides
recommendation.body: Hold this PR until the bulk endpoint consumes `ownerHandle`, then add a live ambiguous-slug proof and merge the compatible client update.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only person connected to the proposed client implementation in the available review context; service-side ownership is not established here.
